title: Wisdom With
author: Allison
description: ENGLISH - Hi and welcome to the Wisdom With Podcast. The Podcast that is empowering you to see beauty in every situation. My name is Allison, I am a vulnerability mentor who is truly obsessed with human connections. It is through my personal introspections and the ones of the resilient humans I interview that we are giving you some insights on how to embrace the full journey that life is. Beauty exists everywhere, even in the most painful moments and choosing to witness it is deciding to connect to our hearts rather than our heads. Together, let's connect to our true selves through this universal beauty that only our hearts can see. FRENCH - Bonjour et bienvenu(e) dans le Wisdom With Podcast. Le podcast qui t'inspire à voir la beauté dans chaque situation. Je m'appelle Allison, je suis une mentor spécialisée en vulnérabilité et totalement amoureuse des connections humaines. C'est à travers mes phases d'introspections et celles des humains résilient que j'interviewe que l'on te donne des pistes de réflexions afin que tu puisses toi aussi accepter tout ce que la vie va te donner.…
